hint.zh: 「对所有 x」说的话，对安也成立：在元件上把 x 换成安。
hint.en: What holds for every x holds for Ann: on the part, put Ann in for x.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>：接进「∀x. …」，在元件上选一样东西，输出就是把 x 换成它的那句话。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>: wire in a “∀x. …”, choose a thing on the part, and out comes the sentence with x replaced by it.
